description: The ZM PRO electric mountain bike features a powerful 1000W motor (1500W peak), massive 52V 60AH battery for up to 200 miles of range, and rugged fat tires. Designed for off-road adventure and urban commuting, this 2025 fastest ebike combines moto-style design, built-in storage, and superior climbing power — the perfect high-performance electric bike for adults.

components.description: The front wheel features a Thru Axle wheel attachment system for tool-free installation. This feature ensures a straight wheel, consistent brake rotor alignment, and handling stability. Remove the wheel in minutes for easy and light-weight transport
hydraulic mineral oil brakes and 180mm rotors (with a thickness of up to 2.3mm)provide ultimate braking power, ensuring your safety whether you're engaging in it.
14-28 tooth, 7-geared freewheel
The ZM PRO's KMC Z8 steel chain offers consistent tension and secure performance throughout your ride.
Forged aluminum, 48-tooth chainring with dual-sided chainring guard is the perfect match for 20-inch fat tires.
Shimano derailleur

Removable Battery: Features a removable battery designed for easy operation and flexibility. With multiple charging options, you can conveniently charge it anywhere, whether at home, at work, or on the go. Built for durability, it's dustproof and waterproof, ensuring a longer range and reliable performance in all conditions.

52V,7.0A, operates on 100V-240V AC power outlets, 5-6 hr charging. A charging port on the bottom of the integrated battery provides riders with the option to charge the eBike without removing the battery. Meanwhile, interchangeable spare batteries can be removed and installed in seconds, doubling your range.
A 1000W rear hub motor (1500W Peak) with 90Nm of torque delivers power and speed quicker than ever before to help you conquer rough terrains with ease.
A backlit, heads-up LCD display provides trip and battery intelligence on the go. lP-65-rated electrical components ensure greater water and dust resistance.

The adjustable front fork boasts a high-strength aluminum alloy Dual Suspension(with up to 80mm of travel ) & Hydraulic Lockout which ensures the comfort of riding under any complex cycling conditions.
Soft ergonomic imitation leather comfort grips offer superior comfort, durability, grip, and style, making them a popular choice among cyclists.
1 Toolkit Box
1 Keys
1 Rear Derailleur Guard
A heavy-duty side-sweeping kickstand located near the chain stay keeps the E-Bike upright.
An integrated safety system, featuring a headlamp and taillight powered by the battery allows you to be seen at any time of day.
Quick-release pedals easily detach from the bike for compact transport.

Engineers meticulously craft the Rear Suspension system which consists of four frame link shocks(including two middle shocks and two rear wheel spring shock absorbers)—high-quality frame link suspension construction that greatly reduces bumps on uneven surfaces.
260*230mm, comfortable ergonomic seat, allowing you to ride for longer periods equipped with a rear reflector, significantly improving safety.
An adjustable and removable seat post allows riders to reach a range of heights while maintaining comfort and stability.

G-FORCE's new PAS Sensor enables the rider to control the eBike's power output effortlessly, eliminating the need for a torque sensor to achieve a smooth riding experience. Instead, the ZM PRO model features a straightforward and cost-effective cadence sensor to ensure seamless rides.
thumb-triggered handlebar shifter

Compared to the handlebar throttle, the half twist throttle design is more ergonomic, offering a natural and comfortable operation that reduces hand fatigue and discomfort, thus enhancing safety and comfort during rides.
Two fat tires provide unparalleled traction and can handle any terrain with ease. Say goodbye to skidding and slipping; Embrace a smooth and comfortable journey.
A 25 amp controller swiftly distributes power to the motor.
Simply attach the quick-release pedals and install the front wheel via the thru-axle.
